vineSrDesc: Learn about your animal companion in Heard
vineInfoP1: We thought everyone could use an animal friend to help them navigate the twists and turns of healthy and sometimes challenging discourse.
vineInfoP2: You can also see other people's animals to see who else is "hanging" around! 🙈
vineStBody: Hey! Just a heads up, the time limit you set has been reached. Taking breaks helps keep the conversation fun and healthy!
